name: Devin
one_liner: Autonomous AI software engineer that writes, runs, and tests code.
auth_notes: Service user API keys (cog_ prefix) sent as Bearer tokens for the MCP server and models endpoint; Devin Desktop API takes service keys in the request body; legacy apk_ keys are rejected by MCP session tools.
access_notes: Devin Desktop usage API is Enterprise-only. MCP server needs a Devin account and an API key generated from account settings. Pricing and plan gate for the core Devin API are not stated in the cached pages.

buildability.rationale: Official MCP server (mcp.devin.ai/mcp) uses self-serve service user keys with Bearer auth and documents session, playbook, and schedule tools. Core REST API docs and plan gating are unverified in cached pages; the Desktop API is Enterprise-only.

identity.quote: Devin is an autonomous AI software engineer that can write, run and test code.

auth.quote: Use a personal access token or a service user key as <API_KEY>.
Service keys must be included in the request body of all API calls.

access.quote: The API is available for Enterprise plans only
Sign up for a Devin account at Devin.ai

api_surface.quote: The Devin Desktop API enables enterprise customers to programmatically access detailed usage analytics
API requests are subject to rate limiting to ensure service stability.

mcp.quote: The Devin MCP server is an authenticated service that provides access to both public and private repositories

buildability.quote: Any Devin session or MCP-compatible client can create sessions, manage playbooks and knowledge, set up schedules, and more.

needs_human_reason: Core Devin v3 REST API docs (api-reference/overview) were not in the cached pages, so docs_url is null and endpoint breadth is unknown. Plan tier and pricing for the core API remain unresolved; only the Desktop API's Enterprise-only gate is documented.
